meaning:
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:28 (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;]
1. potter's clay.
2. an earthen vessel.
3. a tile: Luk.5:19.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle…
